verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents delete-capture and sync-mode controls (Soft Delete/Live/History Mode), plus data blocking, column hashing and row filtering that let users control what data is retained or excluded from sync, and its MCP server exposes a read/write/delete scope for managing connections. However there is no explicit documentation of data retention periods, how long Fivetran retains copies of synced data internally, or a formal deletion/right-to-erasure workflow for end-user data once ingested. Missing for 10: explicit retention-period policy, documented data deletion/erasure workflow for ingested data, independent verification that delete controls work as described.
